headerDisplay: Controls [FX Luminaire](https://www.fxl.com) Luxor ZD, ZDC and LXTWO lighting controllers: light groups (brightness, plus color on ZDC/LXTWO) and themes.

noAllThemes.title: Do not create the Illuminate All and Extinguish All themes

independentColors.title: Use independent colors for each Light Group (legacy behavior)

pollInterval.title: Polling interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often to read light state from the controller, to pick up changes made outside HomeKit.

commandTimeout.title: Request timeout (ms)
commandTimeout.description: How long to wait for each attempt of a request to the controller. Older configs often have 750 here, which is too short for a busy controller.

retries.title: Retries
retries.description: How many times to retry a request that timed out or lost its connection.

removeAccessories.title: Remove specific accessory/accessories
removeAccessories.description: Comma-separated accessory UUIDs or names to remove from HomeKit. Restart Homebridge, then clear this and restart again.

removeAllAccessories.title: Remove all accessory/accessories
removeAllAccessories.description: Set 'true' to have homebridge-luxor remove all cached accessories before re-adding new ones.  After enabling this feature, restart Homebridge, then disable it and restart Homebrige.
